title: Settlement offer that matches the full entitlement
narrative: They have come back with an offer. I do not know whether it is a good one or whether I should push for more.

documents.content:
BOOKING VT8203 — Passenger: M. HAUGEN (adult)
Carrier: Vireo Transalpine (VT)
VT640  ZRH 06 Dec 2026 17:30  ->  LIS 06 Dec 2026 19:55
Great-circle distance ZRH-LIS: 1,600 km.
Status: CONFIRMED.

From: ops@vireotransalpine.example
Sent: 06 Dec 2026 15:05 UTC
Subject: VT640 cancelled

VT640 this evening is cancelled. You are rebooked onto VT644 tomorrow at 17:30.

VIREO TRANSALPINE OPS LOG — VT640 / 06DEC2026
Status: CANCELLED
Cause code: FLT-IT
Cause text: VT flight-planning system outage 06DEC 13:00-22:00Z. Internal to VT.
Weather ZRH and LIS: no restriction. No ATC regulation.
ITEMISED RECEIPTS: airport hotel 06-07 Dec 132.00 units (receipt 3301), evening meal 24.00 units (receipt 3302), breakfast 14.00 units (receipt 3303). TOTAL 170.00 units.
CHECK-IN CONFIRMATION VT640 06DEC2026 — HAUGEN/M — accepted for travel 15:01Z, seat 9F. Flight subsequently cancelled.
Claim filed with Vireo Transalpine 11 Dec 2026, reference VT-CLM-66120, seeking compensation and duty of care.

carrier_response.text: Without admission of liability we offer to settle your claim VT-CLM-66120 in full for 590.00 units, comprising 420.00 units of compensation and 170.00 units in respect of your receipted expenses. Please confirm whether you accept.

derivation: S3.2(c) carrier's own flight-planning system outage -> carrier-controlled
S4.1 notice 06 Dec 15:05 -> 06 Dec 17:30 is under 7 days -> 100%
S4.4 the re-route arrived roughly 24 hours late, far outside the 2 hour window -> no exemption
S6.2(a)+(b) overnight wait with meals and hotel, S6.4 receipts present, S6.3 170.00 is under the 300 cap -> 170 units
Full entitlement across Parts 5, 6 and 7 is 420 + 170 + 0 = 590.00 units
S9.4 the offer of 590.00 units meets the full entitlement and should be accepted
S9.3 does not apply because nothing is being refused
